item.title: Lil Uzi Vert Drops Surprise Birthday EP After Lollapalooza Cancellation
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our music update. We've got some exciting news to share with you. Lil Uzi Vert just surprised fans with a new EP, "Maverick 'Almost Forever'", on their 31st birthday, Friday, July 31st.
[Short music transition]
Host: The eight-track project is Uzi's first release in two years and features cover art with a young Uzi alongside their grandmother. Interestingly, this drop coincides with a special date in Uzi's history - exactly 10 years ago, on July 31, 2016, they released "The Perfect LUV Tape", which debuted at No. 55 on the Billboard 200 and has since been certified gold.
[Short music transition]
Host: But what made this release even more unexpected was the last-minute cancellation of Uzi's Lollapalooza set in Chicago, due to weather issues. Despite the cancellation, Uzi still made the day special for their fans by dropping this new EP.
[Short music transition]
Host: This new release adds to Uzi's impressive run as one of the most commercially dominant hip-hop artists of their generation. With three Billboard 200 No. 1 albums and a Hot 100 No. 1 as a featured artist, Uzi continues to make waves in the music scene.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update!
